tui.editor.hint.quota_monthly: Monthly upload plus download allowance, for example 1 TB or 1 TiB. Blank means no monthly quota.
tui.editor.hint.quota_timezone: IANA timezone used for calendar resets, for example Asia/Shanghai or UTC.
tui.editor.hint.remark: Optional operational note for this rule.
tui.editor.hint.rule_id: Stable configuration ID; it cannot be changed after creation.
